from collections import Counter, defaultdict

access_token = resp['access_token']

# Build mapping playlist_id -> list of song_ids and maybe order
playlist_song_ids = {}
playlist_original_titles = {}
for pl in playlist_details:
    playlist_original_titles[pl['playlist_id']] = pl['title']
    playlist_song_ids[pl['playlist_id']] = [s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs',[])]

print('Playlists and song counts:', {pid: len(ids) for pid, ids in playlist_song_ids.items()})

# Fetch genre for each song
song_genres = {}  # song_id -> genre
for pid, song_ids in playlist_song_ids.items():
    for sid in song_ids:
        if sid in song_genres:
            continue
        details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        # show_song docs say no access_token required
        song_genres[sid] = details.get('genre')
        print('song', sid, 'genre:', song_genres[sid], 'title:', details.get('title'))

print('total songs fetched genres:', len(song_genres))

# Compute most common genre per playlist; tie-break by first appearance order in playlist song list
playlist_most_common_genre = {}
verification_rows = []
for pid, song_ids in playlist_song_ids.items():
    genres_in_order = [song_genres[sid] for sid in song_ids]
    counts = Counter(genres_in_order)
    max_count = max(counts.values())
    tied = {g for g,c in counts.items() if c==max_count}
    # tie-break: first genre in order that is in tied
    chosen = None
    for g in genres_in_order:
        if g in tied:
            chosen = g
            break
    playlist_most_common_genre[pid] = chosen
    verification_rows.append({
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'original_title': playlist_original_titles[pid],
        'genres': genres_in_order,
        'counts': dict(counts),
        'most_common_genre': chosen
    })

for row in verification_rows:
    print('---')
    print(row['playlist_id'], row['original_title'])
    print('genres in order:', row['genres'])
    print('counts:', row['counts'])
    print('chosen:', row['most_common_genre'])

from collections import Counter

print("Task asks: \"Update all my Spotify playlist titles with the most common song genre in that playlist in this format: \"<original_title> | <most_common_genre>\"\"\n")

# Current fetched data
playlist_map = {}
for pl in playlist_details:
    pid = pl['playlist_id']
    original_title = pl['title']
    mcg = playlist_most_common_genre[pid]
    new_title = f"{original_title} | {mcg}"
    playlist_map[pid] = {
        'original_title': original_title,
        'most_common_genre': mcg,
        'new_title': new_title,
        'song_ids': [s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs',[])]
    }

criteria = [
    {
        'Criterion': 'Target playlists',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'Update all my Spotify playlist titles',
        'Implementation': 'Use spotify.show_playlist_library (my playlist library), paginate fully.'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Genre metric',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'with the most common song genre in that playlist',
        'Implementation': 'For each playlist, compute genre frequency across its songs using spotify.show_song(song_id).'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'New title format',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'in this format: "<original_title> | <most_common_genre>"',
        'Implementation': 'Set playlist title to f"{original_title} | {most_common_genre}".'
    }
]

# Count criteria reductions
initial_set = set([p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists])
counts = []
cur_set = set(initial_set)
for c in criteria:
    # criteria don't reduce; but we still report
    next_set = set(initial_set)
    counts.append((c['Criterion'], len(cur_set), len(next_set)))
    cur_set = next_set

print('CRITERIA TABLE')
for row in criteria:
    print(row['Criterion'], '|', row['Exact Quote from Task'], '|', row['Implementation'])

print('\nCRITERIA COUNT (before -> after applying criterion):')
for crit, before, after in counts:
    print(f"{crit}: {before} -> {after}")

# Print target set
print('\nTARGET SET (playlist_id -> new_title)')
for pid, data in sorted(playlist_map.items()):
    print(pid, '=>', data['new_title'])

print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE')
for pid, data in sorted(playlist_map.items()):
    genres_in_order = []
    # rebuild genres in order
    pl = next(p for p in playlist_details if p['playlist_id']==pid)
    for s in pl.get('songs',[]):
        genres_in_order.append(song_genres[s['id']])
    counts_g = Counter(genres_in_order)
    print(f"Playlist: {data['original_title']} | Most common genre: {data['most_common_genre']} | Genre counts: {dict(counts_g)} | New title: {data['new_title']}")

print('About to update playlist titles...')
access_token = resp['access_token']
updates = []
for pid, data in sorted(playlist_map.items()):
    updates.append((pid, data['new_title']))
print('Update list:', updates)

results = []
for pid, new_title in updates:
    try:
        r = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
        results.append((pid, 'ok', r))
        print('updated', pid)
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((pid, 'fail', str(e)))
        print('failed', pid, str(e))

print('Update results summary:', [(pid, status) for pid, status, _ in results])

# Verify by fetching show_playlist
verification = []
for pid, new_title in updates:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    verification.append((pid, pl['title'], new_title, pl['title']==new_title))

print('Post-update verification:')
for row in verification:
    print(row)
